title: graphdbbook
summary: A companion code repository for a graph database book, containing a script that expands a small seed dataset into a larger synthetic one for use in book examples. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with a Metadata object to fit and sample synthetic tabular records from the seed data.
